verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python library driven entirely by a documented, stable Python API (pipeline.run(), dataset access, incremental loading, CLI, MCP server) rather than a GUI, and this is corroborated by runtime probes showing the CLI, init scaffolding, and official MCP server all working keylessly. Community feedback confirms users value doing 'everything via code.' missing for 10: no traditional REST/OpenAPI HTTP API surface (probe shows openapi.json 404s), and no independent third-party audit of API stability/versioning guarantees.
